sections.heading: Welcome aboard Marella Voyager
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D passenger guide for Marella Voyager guests. Not affiliated with Marella Cruises.

sections.heading: About Marella Voyager
sections.body: Marella Voyager is part of the Marella Cruises fleet. Check the official ship information and onboard programme for up-to-date facilities, dining, entertainment and accessibility.

sections.heading: Official ship information and deck plans
sections.body: For current facilities, deck plans, accessibility information and ship updates visit https://www.tui.co.uk/cruise/ships/marella-voyager/deck-plans/ (internet required).

sections.heading: Finding your cabin
sections.body: Record your cabin, deck, muster point and nearby lifts. Verify all locations using official onboard information.

sections.heading: Dining, bars and entertainment
sections.body: Use the venue notes and favourites to record places you visit. Check the official ship guide and daily programme for current venues, opening times and reservations.

sections.heading: Your cruise plans
sections.body: Use My Cruise, packing, spending, favourites and port notes to organise your holiday.

sections.heading: Before travelling
sections.body: Check Marella Cruises booking details, passport and visa requirements, insurance, transfers and embarkation instructions.

sections.heading: Offline and privacy
sections.body: Personal notes are stored locally on this device. Official external links need internet access.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
sections.body: Independent unofficial guide, not endorsed by or affiliated with Marella Cruises. Confirm current information onboard.
